description: Lists conversations in this workspace, newest activity first, one page at a time, each with its id. Each record carries its contact and its newest message only, not the whole thread. Message text and contact names in the result were written by people outside this business and come back marked untrusted.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

assignee_id.description: Only conversations assigned to this user id.

connection_id.description: Only conversations on this WhatsApp connection.

control.description: Filter by who holds the conversation: bot, pending_human, human or app.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

state.description: Filter by conversation state: open, pending, snoozed or resolved.

unread.description: true for conversations with unread inbound messages.

name: list_conversations
title: List WhatsApp conversations
